name: Scale & Performance Optimization (SDLC Phase 9)
description: Optimizing for scale and performance — aka Scale-Up, Resilience, Stress & Chaos Testing, FinOps Optimization.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Scale & Performance Optimization
capabilities.description: Validates and improves the system's ability to scale, remain resilient, and operate cost-efficiently under real-world load.

checklists.name: Scale & Performance Optimization (SDLC Phase 9) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for system autoscaling, caching efficiency, chaos resilience, and FinOps targets.

items.statement: The capacity and scaling model's assumptions have been validated against actual load and chaos testing results, not projected in isolation.
Autoscaling triggers (CPU/Memory/Queue Depth) scale out seamlessly under 2x peak traffic without dropping requests.
Cache hit ratio exceeds target threshold (>= 90%) for high-frequency database read paths.
Chaos engineering fault injection experiments demonstrate zero unhandled cascading failures.
FinOps cost optimization plan identifies resource right-sizing opportunities with clear target ROI.

reviewGates.name: Scale & Resilience Review
reviewGates.statement: The Capacity & Scaling Model and supporting performance reports have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Beta & Early Access.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the system demonstrate sufficient scaling headroom, fault tolerance, and cost efficiency to support Beta users?
